summary: Main Street Capital Corp filed an 8-K announcing its Board declared regular monthly cash dividends of $0.265 per share for July, August, and September 2026, totaling $0.795 per share for Q3 2026, representing a 1.9% sequential and 3.9% year-over-year increase. Additionally, a supplemental dividend of $0.30 per share was declared payable in June 2026. The company has never reduced its regular monthly dividend since its 2007 IPO. No advisor or recommendation was noted. The filing is a routine dividend increase and supplemental distribution, confirming a commitment to capital returns. Watch for future dividend trends and NAV performance to gauge sustainability.
